newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cenbank cuts four repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank cuts four repo rates.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) cut four of its five repo rates on Friday by 0.25 percent each, it said on its Reuters page.
The overnight and one-week repo rates were lowered to 27.50 percent each from 27.75 percent, it said.
The one-week reverse repo rate was brought down to 21.50 percent from 21.75 percent and the one-month reverse repo rate was cut to 22.00 percent from 22.25 percent, it said.
The NBH said it left its overnight reverse repo rate unchanged at 17.50 percent.
The central bank last cut the same four repo rates on December 23.
